## How it works

- [statement] Cursors fetch results in batches. `toArray()` holds matching documents in process memory and can exceed memory limits; the cursor guide recommends `for await...of` for iterative consumption. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] Call await cursor.close() when an application no longer needs a non-exhausted cursor. Closing releases cursor resources in both the client and the server. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] In collection bulk writes, `UpdateOneModel` updates one matching document and `UpdateManyModel` updates all matches. An update model supplies `filter` and `update`; setting `upsert` permits insertion when no document matches. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] For collection bulk updates, UpdateOneModel updates one matching document and UpdateManyModel updates all matching documents. The upsert option creates a document when no document matches and defaults to false. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The quick reference shows query shaping by chaining limit(), sort() and project() on the cursor returned by find(). (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/quick-reference.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] A failed collection bulk write throws MongoBulkWriteError. With ordered set to true, the driver stops further operations; with ordered set to false, it attempts subsequent operations. The error exposes writeErrors, writeConcernErrors and result for inspecting failures and successful work. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The driver repository recommends `instanceof` checks for error handling rather than parsing `error.message` or `error.name`, because error messages can change even in patch releases. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] MongoDB issue NODE-4913 reports `insertedIds` indexes that do not match original mixed-operation positions in an unordered `bulkWrite`; its affected-version field names `4.13.0`. Treat this as a version-scoped bug report rather than evidence that every current bulk-write result is misindexed. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/NODE-4913 · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] Collection.find() returns a cursor rather than immediately materializing all matching documents. The cursor fetches documents in batches; consume the results using asynchronous iteration or an awaited toArray() call. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/quick-reference.md
- [statement] toArray() holds the query results in application memory. Large result sets can exceed memory constraints; the cursor guide recommends considering for await...of instead of collecting all documents at once. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Do not mix cursor access paradigms on one cursor: hasNext() and toArray() modify its state. Do not run asynchronous operations simultaneously on the same cursor; wait for each operation to complete. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] The cursor stream() method returns a Node Readable Stream in object mode, passing JavaScript objects through the pipeline. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] Collection `bulkWrite()` returns `BulkWriteResult` counters including `insertedCount`, `matchedCount`, `modifiedCount`, `upsertedCount`, and `deletedCount`. A `MongoBulkWriteError` exposes write errors, write-concern errors, and results of successful operations. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] A cursor implements AsyncIterator, so for await...of consumes results one document at a time. Manual iteration can instead await hasNext() and then await next(). (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
- [statement] Collection bulkWrite() accepts an array of operation models. A single call can mix insertOne, updateMany and deleteOne operations; model payloads carry document, filter and update fields as appropriate. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/quick-reference.md
- [statement] Collection.bulkWrite() returns a BulkWriteResult with insertedCount, matchedCount, modifiedCount, upsertedCount and deletedCount; matchedCount and modifiedCount are separate result fields. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: Node.js driver CRUD, cursors and bulkWrite
